decisions.rationale: 'aniridia' in the title names the disease itself ('PAX6 mutations in aniridia'), a single defined congenital eye disease with no further categorization.
'Aniridia' is the subject of the sentence and refers to one specific defined disease, not a family of diseases.
'congenital malformation' is a very general descriptor comparable to 'abnormalities' and is not a specific disease name, so it is excluded.

decisions.rationale: 'iris hypoplasia' is a specific, defined ocular malformation with its own clinical concept, not a general term, so it is annotated as a specific disease.
'blindness' names a specific defined visual condition rather than a general term such as 'complications'; it is annotated as a specific disease.
In 'candidate aniridia gene', the disease name modifies the noun 'gene' and is used as a modifier for another concept.
